2.2 Core Concepts

2.2.1 Branching
For a complete overview of git branching, refer to the Pro Git book.
For a TLDR:

Creating and switch to new branch:

git switch [-c|--create] <branch_name>
# e.g. git switch -c issue1234

Create new branch based on the current commit:

git branch branch_name
# e.g. git branch feature/new-feature

Create new branch based on a specific commit:

git branch branch_name commit_hash
# e.g. git branch main 1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j

List all branches (local and remote):

git branch [-a|--all]

Show the name of the current branch:

git branch --show-current


2.2.2 Merging
For more information refer to the Pro Git book.

Merge a branch into your current branch:

git merge branch_name

Edit the merge message:

git merge --edit branch_name

2.3 Conventions at IMPACT

2.3.1 Branching Strategy





---
config:
  logLevel: "debug"
  theme: 'base'
  gitGraph:
    rotateCommitLabel: true
---
gitGraph
   commit id: "Initial commit" tag: "v2024.0.0"
   branch dev
   checkout dev
   commit id: "Start feature A"
   branch feature/feature-a
   checkout feature/feature-a
   commit id: "Develop feature A"
   checkout dev
   merge feature/feature-a tag: "feature merged"
   commit id: "Start feature B"
   branch feature/feature-b
   checkout feature/feature-b
   commit id: "Work on feature B"
   checkout dev
   merge feature/feature-b tag: "feature merged"
   branch release/2025.1.0
   checkout release/2025.1.0
   commit id: "Finalize release (version bump, changelog)"
   checkout main
   merge release/2025.1.0 tag: "v2025.1.0"
   checkout dev
   merge release/2025.1.0 tag: "Back-merge release"

   %% Hotfix
   branch hotfix/2025.1.1
   checkout hotfix/2025.1.1
   commit id: "Fix critical bug"
   checkout main
   merge hotfix/2025.1.1 tag: "v2025.1.1"
   checkout dev
   merge hotfix/2025.1.1 tag: "Back-merge hotfix"
